principle: A later epoch begins only from a qualified, frozen full-world checkpoint. Epochs separate long-horizon emergence from short mechanism development; they do not turn milestone names into rewards or controllers.

epochs.title: 生态承载体与结构化环境
实体主体雏形：利益反馈关系网络

required_evidence: relations are updated from delayed realized costs, benefits and reciprocal consequences rather than fixed SHARE success increments
the feedback network persists across multiple generations and independent seeds
network structure predicts later cooperation or avoidance beyond spatial proximity and kinship
neutralizing feedback while retaining interaction opportunities changes the network and continuation outcomes

epochs.title: Group 主体雏形：规章有效化

required_evidence: group rules are stored as group state rather than copied designer policy
rules measurably constrain or redirect member actions
rule effects persist through member turnover
group-level continuation or resource control changes when rules are neutralized from a shared checkpoint
membership and enforcement arise from relation, interest and order feedback rather than group labels
